title: Post-sync review of TermAl's existing tests: what each protects, behaviour vs code shape, cost, duplicates
acceptance: A recorded inventory covers every TermAl Rust test module and UI and scripts test file, each with what it protects, behaviour versus code-shape dependence, cost class (fast, slow, benchmark-like) and a DELETE, SIMPLIFY or KEEP verdict with a one-line reason.

The findings are prioritised, and each DELETE or SIMPLIFY group above trivial size is filed as its own item with an owner. Benchmark-like tests are routed to the existing benchmarks item w-a04c88d77f6c.
No new static gate, lint or test-policy check is introduced by this review, and nothing in it blocks or delays sync work.
